say:1:1110704001:1.text: We're home! Were you worried sick while we were out? Were you absolutely starving without the good meat that I hunt?
say:1:1110704001:1.source_cn: 回来啦回来啦！我跟索恩出去这么久，大家肚子饿不饿？真令...

say:3:1110704002:1.text: Stop projecting, it seems like you're the one who's hungry!

say:5:1110704003:1.source_cn: 阿尔萨，索恩！你们回来了！

say:7:1110704004:1.text: We heard the news! Of the brave warriors from the Uru Clan who conquered all the trials!
say:7:1110704004:1.source_cn: 我们都听说啦！通过了所有试炼和考验的乌尔氏族勇士！

say:8:1110704005:1.text: It's really you two! We thought it might be some other Soren and Alsa!
say:8:1110704005:1.source_cn: 居然真的是我们的索恩和阿尔萨！还以为是叫同样名字的别人呢！

say:9:1110704006:1.text: Pft! There's no one else out there as cool as Soren and Alsa!
say:9:1110704006:1.source_cn: 居然以为是别人！哪有那么多的索恩和阿尔萨啊……唔？这是...

say:10:1110704007:1.text: Alsa, you'll be happy to hear that we prepared an awesome feast for you two!
say:10:1110704007:1.source_cn: 阿尔萨，不会以为我们连庆功宴都没给你们准备吧？

say:12:1110704008:1.text: With all your favorite foods!! Grilled meat, soup, and... hold on, desserts are on the way!
say:12:1110704008:1.source_cn: 全都是你们喜欢的食物！有烤肉，有汤……稍等，点心马上就来！

say:13:1110704009:0.text: Wait a second! Where did all this come from?! I remember when we left, there was barely enough food to scrape by...
say:13:1110704009:0.source_cn: 等等等等！这些东西是从哪里变出来的？记得我走的时候全部...

say:14:1110704010:1.text: Well... We couldn't let you guys down!
say:14:1110704010:1.source_cn: 我们……不能给阿尔萨和索恩拖后腿啊！

say:15:1110704011:1.text: Yeah! We might be young, but you were already taking care of us when you were our age.
say:15:1110704011:1.source_cn: 没错。我们现在年纪虽小，但你们在像我这么大的时候，已经...

say:17:1110704012:1.text: The Uru Clan is a clan full of heroes, and I wanna live up to the name!
say:17:1110704012:1.source_cn: 我们乌尔氏族是出了英雄的氏族。只要想到这里，就觉得不能...

say:18:1110704013:1.text: And Soren, teach me how to hunt! I can definitely be helpful too!
say:18:1110704013:1.source_cn: 我们也有我们能做的事！索恩，教我打猎吧！

say:20:1110704014:1.text: You're still too young, kiddo. Hunting is dangerous. Let Alsa teach you how to set some traps instead.
say:20:1110704014:1.source_cn: 你还太小，打猎危险。让阿尔萨教你做陷阱吧。

say:21:1110704015:1.text: Aww man! But I wanna go hunting!
say:21:1110704015:1.source_cn: 呜呜！就要打猎就要打猎！

say:22:1110704016:1.text: ... Alright, but first you'll have to prove to me you can swing a club a hundred times.
say:22:1110704016:1.source_cn: ……行吧。不过，要先等到你能挥棍一百下再说吧。

say:25:1110704017:1.text: Ah, it seems like Soren is also growing up. He's handling the kids so well.
say:25:1110704017:1.source_cn: 居然开始和颜悦色？索恩也长大了呀。
